findings.documented: Append it as a query parameter: ?api_key=...
findings.actual: Returns 401 if passed as query. Key must be sent in X-API-Key header.
findings.how_found: Received 401 Unauthorized when requesting any endpoint with api_key in query string.
findings.impact: Cannot make any API calls without changing authentication method.

findings.documented: Listings are public. Only /v1/favourites requires Bearer token.
findings.actual: All v1 endpoints return 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first' without a token.
findings.how_found: Received 401 on /v1/listings when only sending X-API-Key.
findings.impact: Must implement a full login flow just to fetch public data.

findings.documented: Returns { "token": "...", "expires_in": 86400 } and tokens are valid for 24 hours. No refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns { "access_token": "...", "refresh_token": "...", "expires_in": 900 }. Tokens expire in 15 mins and there is a refresh flow at /auth/refresh.
findings.how_found: Logged in using demo credentials and inspected the response body.
findings.impact: Frontend must handle token expiration every 15 minutes and implement refresh.

findings.actual: The API completely ignores 'page'. It requires 'offset' instead.
findings.how_found: Pagination returned the exact same first 50 records endlessly when incrementing 'page'.
findings.impact: Fetching all records fails unless offset is used.

findings.actual: The API ignores max 'limit' of 200 and hard-caps results to 50 per response.
findings.how_found: Requested limit=200 but only 50 records were returned.
findings.impact: Requires 4x more requests to fetch all data.

findings.how_found: Inspecting the JSON structure of collection responses.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching your filters.
findings.actual: The 'total' field says 3320, but the API actually returns 3500 records.
findings.how_found: Iterated until has_more was false and counted 3500 unique listings.
findings.impact: Relying on 'total' to calculate total pages skips the last 180 records.

findings.how_found: Attempted to fetch the endpoint using authenticated GET request.
findings.impact: Must compute analytics manually in the frontend from the raw listings.

findings.documented: Money is in Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: price_max (and price_min) in projects are floats representing Crores (e.g., 98.9), not integers in Rupees.
findings.how_found: Finding the max price returned 98.9, which is impossible as an INR integer.
findings.impact: Displaying prices as INR directly would show 98 Rupees instead of 98 Crores.

findings.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere.
findings.actual: All timestamps lack the Z suffix entirely and are offset-naive.
findings.how_found: Parsing dates in python raised offset-naive errors.
findings.impact: Date comparisons using UTC crash or yield incorrect results.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Returns inactive listings (is_live: false) mixed in with the results.
findings.how_found: Downloaded the entire dataset and found hundreds of records with is_live set to false.
findings.impact: Frontend will display withdrawn/expired listings if not manually filtered.

findings.documented: Every listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple distinct listings (different listing_ids) describe the exact same physical property.
findings.how_found: Grouping properties by physical attributes revealed multiple listing_ids per group.
findings.impact: Overcounts physical properties if listing_ids are assumed strictly 1:1.

findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found. The correct endpoint is plural: /v1/listings/{id}
findings.how_found: Clicking View Details resulted in a 404. Tested /v1/listings/{id} and it worked.
findings.impact: Frontend navigation to detail pages breaks entirely.

findings.actual: Returns 404. The endpoints are actually at /v1/saved.
findings.how_found: Saving failed with 404. Swept endpoints and found /v1/saved returns 200.

findings.actual: Returns 422 Unprocessable Entity. The payload requires { "listing_id": "..." } instead of "id".
findings.how_found: Saving to /v1/saved returned 422. Read the error message which said 'loc: [body, listing_id] Field required'.
findings.impact: Saving properties still fails even on the correct endpoint.

findings.documented: Claims to be the source of truth, stating Gurgaon has 3,626 listings (unauthenticated) or 3,700 listings (authenticated).
findings.actual: The file dynamically hallucinates fake numbers based on API headers. The actual API returns exactly 3,500 records.
findings.how_found: Fetched the file with and without X-API-Key and noticed the numbers mutated. Compared this to the 3,500 records successfully pulled from the API.
findings.impact: Tricks developers into believing they are missing records when they actually have the full dataset.

findings.documented: Supports filtering by bedroom, locality, price_min, price_max, and furnishing.
findings.actual: The API completely ignores all filtering parameters and returns the exact same 3,500 records regardless.
findings.how_found: Requested ?bedroom=6 and received the standard dataset containing 1, 2, and 3 BHKs.
findings.impact: Frontend filtering must be implemented entirely locally.
